papers.title: Weak-Solvating Carboxylate Ester Electrolyte Enables Hybrid Interphase via Cooperative Additives toward Wide-Temperature Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Fast Na+ transport and durable interfacial stability remain challenging for wide-temperature Na- metal batteries. To address these issues, we developed a synergistic solvation-interphase regulation strategy by integrating methyl propanoate (MP) with a combined VC/NaDFOB additive pair. MP modifies the Na+ solvation sheath and facilitates Na+ desolvation, while VC and NaDFOB cooperatively generate a mechanically robust hybrid organicinorganic interphase. This coupled regulation enables enhanced ion transport and interfacial stability over a broad temperature range. The EC/EMC/MP + VC/NaDFOB electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 2.52 mS cm–1 at –40 ̊C and an increased Na+ transference number. Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 cells retain 96.5% of their initial capacity after 1000 cycles with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.98% at room temperature. At –20 ̊C, the cells deliver 69.4 mAh g–1 for over 900 cycles, corresponding to 82% of their room-temperature capacity. This work establishes a practical solvation-interphase regulation approach for wide-temperature Na- metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 메틸프로피오네이트(MP)와 VC/NaDFOB 첨가제를 결합한 약한 용매화 카르복실산 에스터 전해액을 통해 Na+ 탈용매화를 촉진하고 유무기 혼성 계면을 형성하는 전략을 제시했다. 이 전해액은 -40°C에서 2.52 mS/cm의 이온 전도도를 보이며, Na‖Na3V2(PO4)3 셀은 상온에서 1000사이클 후 96.5%의 용량을 유지하고 -20°C에서도 900사이클 이상 안정적으로 작동했다. 광범위한 온도 범위에서 소듐 금속 전지의 계면 안정성과 이온 수송을 동시에 개선한 사례이다.

papers.title: Quantifying Sodium Metal SEI Dissolution and Relation to Corrosion Using Quartz Crystal Microbalance
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium-metal batteries present a more abundant alternative to lithium-based batteries, with high theoretical capacity and comparable reduction potential. Ether electrolytes perform well in sodium-metal batteries under continuous cycling and are presumed to have a stable solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI). However, the solubility of sodium SEI components is a cause for concern, and SEI evolution during calendar aging is not commonly studied for the ether sodium-metal system. In this work, SEI mass formation and dissolution are quantitatively measured for NaPF6 in diglyme. For varying potential hold levels, significant SEI dissolution is observed, from 55 to 76% of the originally formed SEI. Characterization shows that in addition to organic component dissolution, inorganic salts such as NaF and NaxPOyFz are unstable in SEI during open circuit rest. This instability results in continuous corrosion of sodium metal during calendar aging, highlighting an important understanding and concern of SEI stability in sodium-metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 수정 결정 미세저울(QCM)을 이용해 에터계 전해질(디글라임 중 NaPF6)에서 형성된 소듐 금속 SEI의 용해 거동을 정량적으로 측정했다. 개방 회로 휴지 중 SEI 질량의 55~76%가 용해되며, NaF 및 NaxPOyFz 등 무기 성분도 불안정하여 소듐 금속의 지속적인 부식을 유발함을 밝혔다. 이는 에터 전해질 기반 소듐 금속 전지의 저장(calendar aging) 안정성에 대한 우려를 제기한다.

papers.title: Thermodynamic Suppression of Deprotonation in Succinonitrile‐Based Electrolyte for Durable Solid‐State Sodium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries (SSMBs) offer a low‐cost, safe, and high‐energy‐density energy‐storage technology. While succinonitrile (SN) is widely adopted in solid and gel electrolytes for its high dielectric constant, exceptional oxidative stability, and robust cathode compatibility, its practical application is limited by parasitic reactions with Na metal, including deprotonation and polymerization. Herein, we demonstrated a thermodynamic suppression strategy of deprotonation that substantially inhibits parasitic reactions in SN‐based electrolytes for durable SSMBs. By utilizing an acrylonitrile (AN) based polymer as the host framework, we establish an optimized interaction with free SN that thermodynamically disfavors the parasitic decomposition, effectively stabilizing the α‐hydrogens of the methylene groups against deprotonation. The rationally designed electrolyte exhibits high ionic conductivity of 2.17 mS cm −1 and exceptional compatibility with Na metal, enabling stable cycling of Na | Na symmetric cells for 6200 h. Na | Vanadium phosphate sodium full cells retain 95.6% capacity after 5000 cycles at 1.0 C, 93.4% after 10000 cycles at 2.0 C, and pouch cells with an ultra‐high cathode loading of 20 mg cm −2 demonstrate stable performance. This work establishes thermodynamic suppression of deprotonation as a foundational design principle for high‐energy‐density and long‐lifespan SSMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 숙시노니트릴(SN) 기반 고체 전해질에서 소듐 금속과의 부반응(탈양성자화 및 중합)을 억제하기 위해 아크릴로니트릴(AN) 기반 고분자 호스트로 자유 SN과의 상호작용을 조절하는 열역학적 억제 전략을 제시했다. 이 전해질은 2.17 mS/cm의 높은 이온 전도도와 우수한 Na 금속 호환성을 보여 Na|Na 대칭 셀이 6200시간 동안 안정적으로 작동했고, Na|인산바나듐소듐 풀셀은 1.0C에서 5000사이클 후 95.6%, 2.0C에서 10000사이클 후 93.4%의 용량을 유지했다. 20 mg/cm² 고로딩 파우치 셀에서도 안정적인 성능을 보여 고에너지밀도 고체 소듐 금속 전지의 설계 원칙을 제시한다.
